P1.sampleCompetence: Develop number sense up to 20 and perform simple operations
P1.sampleObjective: Learners should be able to identify numbers from 1 to 20 and perform addition within 20.
P1.sampleIntro: Show counters; ask learners to count aloud to 20.
P1.sampleDevelopment: Group activity: count sets of objects; teacher models addition using counters; learners practice in pairs.
P1.sampleConclusion: Recap counting rules and check understanding with quick questions.
P1.sampleEval: Give short oral quiz: addition problems within 20.

P4.sampleCompetence: Understand basic fractions and their representation
P4.sampleObjective: Learners should be able to recognise 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 of shapes and sets.
P4.sampleIntro: Show a circle; fold to show halves and quarters.
P4.sampleDevelopment: Hands-on folding activity; matching shapes to fraction labels.
P4.sampleConclusion: Learners explain how they found halves/quarters.
